name: Aka-chan Hoshii na ~Kyou kara Hajimaru Love Love Ecchi~
original_name: 赤ちゃんほしいな ～今日からはじまる妊活えっち～
source:
"I want to bear your child", these are the words that Tsukumi uttered during their first sexual intercourse right after they got married. Tsukumi is a former graduate student of the highschool where Shousuke, our male protagonist is working at. At that one fateful last day of school she collected all her strength and confessed to him to become his wife. Shousuke accepted it.

And so it happened. After losing her virginity to him she mentions her most desired wish of giving birth to a child. Unfortunately this task is not easy to fulfill because Shousuke is diagnosed with weak and low amounts of capable sperm. 

But Tsukumi doesn't let these circumstances bring her down and tells her lover: "It might not be easy for you, but that doesn't mean it is impossible for us" - And thats how their Love Love Ecchi Life begins.
